title: Disney Animal Kingdom – level 1
paragraphs: Disney loves animals and wants to help them. They have a big hospital for animals.

The staff prepares 1,500 different diets. They give the animals 4,500 kilograms of food every day. They want to save threatened animals, like lions, giraffes, and rhinos, and help them live in their homes.
Disney gives lots of money to protect animals. They use bees to keep elephants away from farms. They want to help butterflies by planting milkweed in gardens.

words.d: people who work in one company
an animal which is in danger and may not exist anymore
a plant which has white milky sap, and butterflies like it
